title: THE HEAVY HELMET CREST IS STEEL, NOT A NEON BAR
why: The char-art brief lists the neon green bar on the Heavy helmet as a glitch to fix. The crest was one solid bar in the scheme accent, and on the Toxic scheme worn by the Heavy set that is #8dff2e. The crest is now steel with a lit top edge, and the accent is only a thin half-strength stripe down it.
now: The Heavy helmet crest is steel with a thin accent stripe instead of a neon bar.
